document.title: CLOUD SERVICES AGREEMENT
document.intro: This Cloud Services Agreement is entered into as of January 15, 2026 by and between Northstar Analytics, Inc. (Provider) and Acme Manufacturing LLC (Client).
document.definedTermClause: “Service Credit” means the credit stated in Exhibit A that is applied against a future invoice after a verified service-level failure.
document.definedTermUse: Client's sole monetary remedy for a service-level failure is the applicable Service Credit.
document.definedTermDecoy: For avoidance of doubt, the phrase “service credit review” in an operations ticket is not a defined term and must remain lower case.
document.servicesClause: Provider shall use commercially reasonable efforts to make the hosted service available in accordance with Exhibit A.
document.feesClause: Client shall pay the fees in the following economics schedule within thirty (30) days after receipt of an undisputed invoice.
document.confidentialityClause: Provider shall keep Client Confidential Information confidential and use it only to perform this Agreement.
document.crossReferenceClause: See Section 4 for confidentiality obligations that survive termination.
document.noticeClause: A notice of nonrenewal is effective only if received at least thirty (30) days before the renewal date.
document.noticeDecoy: Operational incident notices are due within thirty (30) days after discovery and are not renewal notices.
document.liabilityClause: Except for excluded claims, each party's aggregate liability will not exceed the fees paid or payable during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to liability.
document.governingLawClause: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflicts-of-law rules.
signatureLines: Name: Jordan Rivera | Title: Chief Executive Officer
Name: Morgan Lee | Title: General Counsel
document.exhibitText: Monthly Availability Target: 99.95%. Service Credit tiers are calculated from the monthly subscription fee.
